description: Defines data models and in-memory storage for defect management system, including classes for User, ImageRef, RcaData, CorrectiveAction, Defect, and a thread-safe store with seed data.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user with id, email, name, and role.

classes.name: ImageRef
classes.description: Represents an image reference with URL, name, and upload timestamp.

classes.name: RcaData
classes.description: Minimal root cause analysis data model with five whys, fishbone categories, and notes.

classes.name: CorrectiveAction
classes.description: Represents a corrective action linked to a defect, with status and timestamps.

classes.name: Defect
classes.description: Represents a defect with details including severity, status, description, images, RCA, and corrective actions.

classes.name: InMemoryStore
classes.description: Thread-safe in-memory store managing users, defects, and actions with seed data.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns current UTC time in ISO format without microseconds.

methods.name: _seed
methods.description: Initializes store with default users and defects.
